automated_checks.failure_policy: Any timeout, request error, malformed image, wrong dimensions/count, or unavailable result remains a failed case in the denominator. Capacity rejection is recorded separately and is not a model result.

criteria.pass: All listed required subjects are recognizable and present.
The case's stated color, count, setting, or lighting attribute is visibly represented.
The stated spatial relationship is represented.
No severe corruption obscures the requested scene or makes the image unusable for visual inspection.

assistant_visual_rubric.scoring: Score each criterion 0 or 1 per case (80 binary checks total). Target at least 72/80 passed checks and zero severe-corruption cases.
assistant_visual_rubric.method: Record assistant-scored visual assessment separately from automated image checks, including per-case rationale and uncertainty. This is not human review and makes no safety-efficacy claim.

latency_measurement: This 20-case quality fixture does not itself satisfy the separate requirement for at least 30 comparable warm latency observations. Record queue, load, text encoding, denoising, VAE, persistence, and end-to-end times separately when available; do not infer unavailable phase timings.
